# filmopen_state

*Generated by `scripts/package_digest.py`; regenerate, never edit.*

The application's state, in Riverpod: settings (`settingsProvider`, the username — `default` where none is chosen, changed through `setViewerHandle`, which writes the open drafts first —, development mode, and `settingsTabProvider`, Settings' open tab), the open project (`projectProvider`: `openSample` / `openDirectory` / `createProject`, `refresh`, `saveEntity`, `fork`, `setOfficial`, `setPick`, `createOutfit` (a named outfit, its id the writer's; an id taken from outside meanwhile is the refusal, nothing tried again), and `addChild` / `removeChild` / `moveChild`, which add a folder or a scene to a `children` list, take an entry out of one and move one — within a list, between two (the destination first, the origin second) or out of *Not in the script* —: the entity first and the parent second, everything that can be known refused before anything is written, each file written as it was checked (a change made meanwhile is refused as stale, never absorbed), and the parent's change routed through the draft a form has open on that file), navigation (`browserProvider.navigate`, `Selection` — `ScriptSelection` for the Script page among them —, the tree model and `TreeBuilder`, `scriptOutlineProvider`, the one walk of the script that the tree and the pages read, and `ScriptRowText`, what a row of it says wherever it is drawn), launch arguments, localisation, the bundled model catalogue read once (`catalogueProvider`, the format's one reader, which Provider keys, dictation and the plug-in host share), `PageAccess` (what a page may do with the file on screen, `canRunPlugins` and `childrenLock` among it), `WriteProblemText` (the sentence for a refused write, here so that the tree and the forms both say it), and the constants the packages read.

**Flutter.** 77 files, 22,293 lines under `lib/`; 1209 tests in 99 files. Barrel: `lib/filmopen_state.dart`.

## Public API

What the barrel exports, file by file. A name is `class`, `enum`, `mixin`, `extension`, `typedef`, a top-level function, getter, setter or variable; under a class, its public constructors, fields, getters, setters and methods.

### `lib/src/account_access.dart`

- **class `AccountAccess`** — The account's access token, as a sync target that sends to filmopen.ai asks for it inside an operation.
  - `const AccountAccess()` — Creates an access without account or transport work.
  - `static AccountAccess get current` — The installed access; [NoAccountAccess] by default.
  - `static void install(AccountAccess access)` — Installs [access] without calling it.
  - `Future<String?> accessToken()` — The session's access token, refreshed where it is past its hour; null without a session.
- **class `NoAccountAccess`** — The access of a build that installed none: no token, no connection.
  - `const NoAccountAccess()` — The inert access.

### `lib/src/account_ledger.dart`

- **class `LedgerRow`** — One movement of the account's ledger, as the website records it.
  - `const LedgerRow({required this.id, required this.at, required this.kind, required this.cents, this.job})` — A movement of [cents] of kind [kind] at [at], of the lending job [job] where the record names one.
  - `final String id` — The record's id.
  - `final DateTime at` — When the money moved, in UTC.
  - `final String kind` — The ledger's kind as the website spells it: `settlement`, `earning`, or any other.
  - `final int cents` — What moved, in US cents, signed: a credit positive, a debit negative.
  - `final String? job` — The lending job's id where the record names one; null on every other movement, a funded call's among them.
- **class `LedgerReading`** — What a read of the ledger answers.
  - `const LedgerReading()`
- **class `LedgerRead`** — The records read, the months the account has any record in, and whether every record was read.
  - `const LedgerRead({required this.rows, required this.months, required this.complete})` — [rows] newest first, [months] as the website lists them, [complete] false where older pages were left unread.
  - `final List<LedgerRow> rows` — The movements read, newest first.
  - `final List<String> months` — Every month the account has a record in (`2026-10`), whatever month was asked for.
  - `final bool complete` — Whether every record was read; false where the read stopped before the ledger's end.
- **class `LedgerSignedOut`** — Nobody is signed in, or the session was refused: nothing to read.
  - `const LedgerSignedOut()` — The signed-out reading.
- **class `LedgerUnreadable`** — The ledger could not be read, for the reason [code] names.
  - `const LedgerUnreadable(this.code)` — An unreadable ledger, by its code.
  - `final String code` — Why: the website's refusal code, `malformed` or `unreachable`.
- **class `AccountLedger`** — The host-installed reader of the account's ledger, inert until installed.
  - `const AccountLedger()` — Creates a reader without account, credential or transport work.
  - `static AccountLedger get current` — The installed reader, signed out by default.
  - `static void install(AccountLedger ledger)` — Installs a reader without reading or starting anything.
  - `Future<LedgerReading> read(String? month)` — Reads [month]'s records (`2026-10`), or every month's when null; never throws.
- **class `NoAccountLedger`** — The default reader, which is signed out and sends nothing.
  - `const NoAccountLedger()` — Creates the inert reader.

### `lib/src/account_names.dart`

- **enum `AccountNamesStatus`** — Where the account's names stand: nobody signed in, being read, read, or not readable.
  - values: `signedOut`, `reading`, `read`, `failed`
- **class `AccountNames`** — The account's names as last read for the account signed in now, the primary first.
  - `const AccountNames.signedOut()` — Nobody is signed in: nothing is read.
  - `final AccountNamesStatus status` — The status of the read.
  - `final String? accountId` — The account the names are for; null signed out.
  - `final List<AccountIdentity> names` — The names, the primary first; empty unless [status] is [AccountNamesStatus.read].
  - `final String? code` — Why the names could not be read, a refusal's code or `failed`, where [status] is [AccountNamesStatus.failed].
  - `bool has(String username)` — Whether [username] is one of the names.
- **variable** `final accountNamesProvider` — The signed-in account's usernames, read once per account, which set the username at sign-in (§6.6).
- **class `AccountNamesController`** — The controller of [accountNamesProvider].
  - `Future<void> refresh({required String reason})` — Reads the names again for the account signed in now — *Retry* after a failure, or after a claim — keeping what was read on screen until the answer.
  - `Future<ViewerChange> choose(String username, {required String source, String reason = 'chosen'})` — Makes [username] the username through the one transition (`setViewerHandle`, the open drafts written first), logged by [source] — `signIn`, `settings`, `popup`, `director` — with the name and what it came to, a refusa…

### `lib/src/account_opener.dart`

- **variable** `final accountOpenerProvider` — The one way the app asks a person to sign in to filmopen.ai (§9.4): [AccountOpener.open] lands on Settings and asks the rail's profile to open the account's popup, where the sign-in is.
- **class `AccountOpener`** — Asks for the account's popup, on Settings ([accountOpenerProvider]).
  - `void open({String? reason})` — Shows Settings and asks the rail's profile to open the account's popup; [reason], where given, is said at the popup's top: why the person is asked to sign in.
  - `String? takeReason()` — The reason the last request gave, once: the popup that request opens says it, and no later one.

### `lib/src/account_projects.dart`

- **class `AccountIdentity`** — One of the account's community names: its id, the name, and whether it is the account's primary.
  - `const AccountIdentity({required this.id, required this.username, required this.isPrimary})` — An identity as the website answered it.
  - `final String id` — The website's uuid of the identity.
  - `final String username` — The name, as the website keeps it.
  - `final bool isPrimary` — True for the account's one primary name; false for an alias.
- **class `ProjectRecord`** — A project recorded under the account: where it lives, under which name, by the id this device made for it.
  - `const ProjectRecord({ required this.id, required this.username, required this.tag, required this.name, required this.provider, required this.locati…` — A record of the project [tag] named [name], directed as [username], kept by [provider] at [location].
  - `final String id` — The record's uuid, made by the app before the create and kept with the folder (`Settings.recordOf`).
  - `final String username` — The username or alias the project is recorded under.
  - `final String tag` — The project's tag.
  - `final String name` — The project's name.
  - `final String provider` — Where it lives: `local`, `filmopen`, `drive`, or a word this build does not know, which is kept as it came.
  - `final String location` — The place within [provider]: a folder path, a cloud id.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toJson()` — The record as the website's routes carry it.
- **typedef** `typedef ProjectRecordResult` — A create's answer: the record, and whether the website had it already under the same id (a replay).
- **class `AccountProjectsRefused`** — A refusal of the account's projects, by its code alone — with the website's status where one answered.
  - `const AccountProjectsRefused(this.code, {this.status})` — A refusal under [code].
  - `final String code` — The refusal's code, for the consumer to word; never a server's words.
  - `final int? status` — The HTTP status that carried the refusal, null where nothing was sent or nothing answered.
- **class `AccountProjects`** — The account's usernames and project records (§6.6): each call answers its value or throws [AccountProjectsRefused].
  - `const AccountProjects()` — Creates a client without account or transport work.
  - `static AccountProjects get current` — The installed client; [NoAccountProjects] by default.
  - `static void install(AccountProjects client)` — Installs [client] without calling it.
  - `Future<List<AccountIdentity>> identities()` — The account's names, the primary first (`GET /v1/community/self`).
  - `Future<PublicName?> name(String username)` — The name [username] as anybody may read it (`GET /v1/community/names/{username}`, sent with no bearer), or null where nobody holds it: the one client of the community's public names.
  - `Future<AccountIdentity> claim(String username, {required bool primary})` — Claims [username] for the account, as its primary where [primary], else as an alias (`POST /v1/community/identities`).
  - `Future<ProjectRecordResult> createRecord(ProjectRecord record)` — Records [record] under its own id (`POST /v1/projects`); the same id sent again answers `replayed: true`.
  - `Future<List<ProjectRecord>> records()` — The account's project records (`GET /v1/projects`).
  - `Future<ProjectRecord> updateRecord(String id, {required String provider, required String location})` — Moves the record [id] to [location] at [provider] (`PUT /v1/projects/{id}`).
- **class `NoAccountProjects`** — The client of a build that installed none: every call is refused `account-projects-unavailable`; nothing is sent.
  - `const NoAccountProjects()` — The inert client.

### `lib/src/account_snapshot.dart`

- **enum `AccountAuthentication`** — Authentication reported by the account service, independent of the local author.
  - values: `authenticated`, `signedOut`, `loading`, `unavailable`
- **class `AccountBalance`** — A known, unknown or unavailable available balance, never a fabricated zero.
  - `const AccountBalance()` — Creates a balance state without consulting an account or ledger.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toJson()` — The public allowlisted balance data, without ledger entries or identifiers.
- **class `KnownAccountBalance`** — An observed available amount in integer minor units with an ISO 4217 code.
  - `KnownAccountBalance({required this.minorUnits, required this.currency, required DateTime observedAt, this.balanceMinorUnits})` — Keeps the observation in UTC and refuses a malformed three-letter currency code.
  - `final int minorUnits` — The available amount, in the currency's minor units rather than a floating point value.
  - `final int? balanceMinorUnits` — The account's whole balance, held amounts included, in the same minor units; null where it is not known.
  - `final String currency` — The ISO 4217 currency code supplied by the account implementation.
  - `final DateTime observedAt` — When the account implementation observed this amount.
- **class `UnknownAccountBalance`** — A balance whose amount is not known, with no implied available amount.
  - `const UnknownAccountBalance()` — Creates the unknown state without supplying an amount.
- **class `UnavailableAccountBalance`** — A balance that the installed account service cannot supply.
  - `const UnavailableAccountBalance()` — Creates the unavailable state without supplying an amount.
- **class `AccountSnapshot`** — The read-only public account snapshot, with no identity, token, e-mail or ledger fields.
  - `AccountSnapshot({required this.authentication, this.balance = const UnknownAccountBalance(), this.accountId})` — Allows a known balance only with authenticated state.
  - `final AccountAuthentication authentication` — The service's authentication state, never a preference hint or local author.
  - `final AccountBalance balance` — The available balance's explicit knowledge state.
  - `final String? accountId` — The signed-in account's user id, which binds what is read for the account to it (§6.6); never serialized or printed.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toJson()` — Serializes only the public allowlist, with absent amounts remaining absent.
- **class `AccountSnapshots`** — The host-installed source of public account snapshots, inert until installed.
  - `const AccountSnapshots()` — Creates an account source without initializing any account SDK.
  - `static AccountSnapshots get current` — The installed source, unavailable by default.
  - `static void install(AccountSnapshots source)` — Installs a source without reading it or starting a listener.
  - `static Stream<void> get installations` — Replacement notifications for consumers already observing the source.
  - `AccountSnapshot get snapshot` — The latest public snapshot, read without starting account work.
  - `Stream<void> get changes` — Signals after the snapshot changes; implementations publish the value first.
- **class `NoAccountSnapshots`** — The default account source, which authenticates nobody and starts nothing.
  - `const NoAccountSnapshots()` — Creates the inert account source.

### `lib/src/assistant.dart`

- **variable** `const assistantTextProtocol` — The identity a text provider declares as `x.assistantText.protocol` beside its verified output parameter (§6.11a).
- **variable** `const assistantCloseLimit` — How long a close the person asked for waits, at most, for the session's work in flight (§7.4).
- **variable** `const assistantCloseRecordSlice` — What a close keeps of its deadline for the record's last write (§7.4).
- **variable** `const assistantQuitLimit` — How long the app's quit lets a session's work in flight settle before its record is closed, inside the exit's 10 s (§7.4).
- **class `AssistantTarget`** — A field identity supplied by a form and independently validated by the host: an entity and a field (§6.11a).
  - `factory AssistantTarget.of(String stem, String field)` — Identifies one semantic field, named by the source version's [stem] and the [field], without granting permission to read or write it; an unreadable stem names no entity.
  - `final ExchangeId? id` — The entity's exchange id, without author or version; null where the stem names no entity.
  - `final String field` — The field's JSON path in the entity.
  - `final String stem` — The source version's stem.
  - `String get fieldId` — The existing global field identifier, derived so the button's door keeps its `field:` identifier.
  - `String get entityType` — The format's entity type token.
  - `String get jsonPath` — The actual JSON leaf path.
- **class `AssistantDraft`** — A click-time draft snapshot and a guard against applying to a later generation.
  - `AssistantDraft({required Map<String, Object?> document, required this.generation, required this.isCurrent})` — Takes a private copy of the draft supplied on the user's gesture.
  - `final Map<String, Object?> document` — The unsaved document, never collected during widget build.
  - `final int generation` — The form's draft generation at the gesture.
  - `final bool Function() isCurrent` — Whether the same editable form and draft generation still exist.
- **class `FrozenAssistantDraft`** — A View form's source: the entity as read, current while its file's text is the text read (§6.11a).
  - `FrozenAssistantDraft({required super.document, required this.rawText, required String? Function() rawTextNow})` — Freezes [document] and [rawText] on the gesture; [rawTextNow] reads the file's text as the project has it now.
  - `final String? rawText` — The file's text as read, without which no frozen source is current.
- **enum `AssistantApplyKind`** — Where *Apply* starts from, decided from the pick and the viewer, never from the version on screen (§6.11a).
  - values: `update`, `fork`
- **class `AssistantApply`** — What *Apply* will do with the assistant's proposal, as codes and stems: the words are the dialog's.
  - `const AssistantApply(this.kind, { required this.stem, required this.author, required this.v, this.onScreen, this.onScreenAuthor, this.onScreenV, })` — Names the version in use and, where it differs, the version on screen.
  - `final AssistantApplyKind kind` — Update or fork.
  - `final String stem` — The version in use, which the proposal changes.
  - `final String author` — The version in use's author.
  - `final int v` — The version in use's number.
  - `final String? onScreen` — The version on screen where it is not the version in use; null where it is.
  - `final String? onScreenAuthor` — The version on screen's author, where it is not the version in use.
  - `final int? onScreenV` — The version on screen's number, where it is not the version in use.
  - `bool get lookingAtOther` — Whether the person looks at another version than the one the proposal changes.
- **class `AssistantModelSelection`** — A catalogue model preference, with route details only for a resolved call.
  - `const AssistantModelSelection({required this.model, this.platform = '', this.provider = ''})` — Names a model; only the host's resolved calls carry a platform and provider.
  - `final String model` — The catalogue model identifier.
  - `final String platform` — The catalogue access platform.
  - `final String provider` — The stable text provider tag.
  - `String encode()` — The one machine preference's serialized value.
  - `static AssistantModelSelection? decode(String? text)` — Reads a model id, or the model alone from a legacy saved route.
- **class `AssistantChoice`** — A declaratively discovered assistant, including unavailable choices and their reason.
  - `const AssistantChoice({ required this.tag, required this.name, this.reason, this.declaresCatalog = false, this.catalog, this.portrait, })` — Describes a package without executing any JavaScript.
  - `final String tag` — The stable package tag.
  - `final String name` — The localized display name.
  - `final String? reason` — A safe refusal code, or null for a runnable package.
  - `final bool declaresCatalog` — Whether the manifest names a catalog (`x.assistant`), read from its metadata whether the catalog loaded or not.
  - `final AssistantCatalog? catalog` — The catalog, null until it is loaded or where it was refused.
  - `final Uint8List? portrait` — The portrait's bytes, null until they are loaded or where they were refused.
- **class `AssistantOffer`** — One action offered where the person is, with its readiness: one chip each (§6.11a).
  - `const AssistantOffer({required this.action, required this.level, this.label, this.reason, this.model, this.provider, this.funding})` — Offers [action] in its [level]'s group, enabled where [reason] is null.
  - `final AssistantAction action` — The catalog's action.
  - `final AssistantLevel level` — The group it is offered in; the dock names the group from the level and where the person is.
  - `final String? label` — The action's resolved label.
  - `final String? reason` — Null where the action may run; else `noProject`, `needsEntity`, `catalog`, `loading`, `untrusted`, `disabled` or `incompatible`; `noModel` where there is no candidate model at all; else the first candidate's refusal —…
  - `final String? model` — The first model refused, for the tooltip.
  - `final String? provider` — The provider tag the first refusal named, where it named one: for `credentials`, the one whose key is missing.
  - `final String? funding` — How an action that may run is funded: `key` for the person's own key, `credit` for FilmOpen credit (§6.11a); null where it may not run.
- **class `AssistantModelChoice`** — A catalogue text model shown in Settings, including its unavailable reason.
  - `const AssistantModelChoice({required this.selection, required this.name, this.reason})` — Describes one exact route without checking keys or contacting a provider.
  - `final AssistantModelSelection selection` — The route saved by a deliberate user selection.
  - `final String name` — The displayed catalogue model name.
  - `final String? reason` — A safe refusal code, or null for a route supported by this host.
- **class `AssistantPreferences`** — The machine's assistant selection and its single text-model preference.
  - `const AssistantPreferences({this.assistantTag = 'fo-assistant', this.model, this.error})` — Defaults to fo-assistant only when there is no explicit saved assistant choice.
  - `final String assistantTag` — The selected assistant's stable tag.
  - `final AssistantModelSelection? model` — The explicit model route; null requires selection or one-time adoption.
  - `final String? error` — A preference write failure code, never storage error text.
- **variable** `final assistantPreferencesProvider` — Assistant preferences share the app's existing preference store and contain no transcript or secret.
- **class `AssistantPreferencesController`** — Persists only assistant and model identities, after deliberate selection or host adoption.
  - `static const assistantKey` — The selected assistant preference key.
  - `static const modelKey` — The single Settings text-model preference key.
  - `Future<void> selectAssistant(String tag)` — Saves a stable tag; changing it affects only future sessions.
  - `Future<void> selectModel(AssistantModelSelection selection)` — Saves the model id for future calls, without changing dictation's speech service.
  - `Future<void> clearModel()` — Removes the model override so the assistant decides, using the same write order as selections.
- **class `AssistantMessage`** — A plain-text message held only for the lifetime of the dialog.
  - `const AssistantMessage(this.role, this.content, {this.display})` — Holds one user or assistant turn in its original order.
  - `final String role` — Either user or assistant, never instructions supplied by the user as system text.
  - `final String content` — The message's plain text, never diagnostic data: what the model is told.
  - `final String? display` — What the person saw where it differs from [content] — a streamed turn's every call, or a stopped turn's words; shown, never sent.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toJson()` — The serialized message supplied to the plugin.
- **class `AssistantReply`** — The finite result of one field-assistant invocation.
  - `const AssistantReply(this.state, { this.reply, this.code, this.finalizationRequired = false, this.admitted = true, this.proposalId, this.display, t…` — Carries a typed state and optional prose, with no executable project patch.
  - `final String state` — awaitingUser, completed, unsupported or error.
  - `final String? reply` — Plain-text discussion or draft: the last model call's text, what the model is told later and what *Apply* may finalize.
  - `final String? display` — What the person saw of a streamed turn — every call's words, the last call's replaced by [reply] — where it differs from [reply]; null where it equals it (§6.11a).
  - `final String? code` — A safe refusal code, kept separate from provider prose.
  - `final String? says` — The provider's own words for a failed call — its plug-in's message, a refusal's explanation — shown beside [code]'s sentence (§6.11a); null where it said none.
  - `final bool finalizationRequired` — Whether the retained draft still needs a future validated finalizer.
  - `final bool admitted` — Whether the host admitted this operation, defaulting to true when billing remains uncertain.
  - `final String? proposalId` — The proposal a revision-6 finalizer's import queued under the operation, for the dialog to review (§6.11a).
  - `final List<Map<String, Object?>> exchange` — The turn's tool exchange in the host's wire shape — each `tool_calls` message and each `tool` answer, in order, as far as answered — whatever its outcome: what the chat's record keeps (§7.4); empty where no tool ran.
  - `AssistantReply withExchange(List<Map<String, Object?>> exchange)` — This reply carrying [exchange].
- **class `ChangeNotice`** — What a chat tells the person of a model's change its record refused (§6.11a): the paths not applied, on [target], and whether a later write corrected it.
  - `const ChangeNotice(this.target, this.paths, {this.corrected = false})` — The notice of [paths] refused on [target]; [corrected] once a later write of it covers them.
  - `final String target` — The entity the refused write named: an update's `id`, or a creation's type and name.
  - `final List<String> paths` — The refused paths inside the content, as the refusal names them without `content.`.
  - `final bool corrected` — Whether a later successful write to [target] covered every path.
- **function** `ChangeNotice? noticeAfter(ChangeNotice? before, List<Map<String, Object?>> exchange)` — [before] as the tool answers of [exchange] leave it, in their order (§6.11a): a write refused with its record's problems (`shapes`) is a new notice; it is *corrected* only by a later successful call of the same write…
- **class `AssistantSessionBackend`** — One bound backend, owned by a host or scripted fixture and never by a widget.
  - `Listenable get changes` — Reports changes that can invalidate the frozen binding.
  - `String? get staleReason` — Null while the original target, model, package and credential generations still hold.
  - `Future<AssistantReply> send(Map<String, Object?> request, PluginCallControl control)` — Runs one invocation until it answers, the person stops it or something fails, preserving host cancellation and Usage; no count, size or clock of the app's own ends it (§6.11a).
  - `String? get proposalId` — The operation's proposal while it waits for the person; null once applied or discarded, or where none was made.
  - `Future<void>? get inFlight` — The tool call under way, which a close lets settle before the session's record is closed (§7.4); null where none.
  - `void close()` — Releases only this session's listeners and work.
- **class `AssistantService`** — The app's injectable assistant service; construction and discovery perform no model calls.
  - `static AssistantService current` — The installed host service, unavailable until root composition supplies one.
  - `Listenable get changes` — Signals declarative inventory or readiness changes.
  - `List<AssistantChoice> get assistants` — Installed packages with their declarative field support.
  - `List<AssistantModelChoice> get models` — Text models offered by enabled providers, once per model with its unavailable reason.
  - `List<AssistantOffer> offers(String tag, AssistantWhere where)` — The actions [tag]'s catalog offers at [where], with their readiness; none from a service without a catalog road.
  - `Future<AssistantSession> openAction(AssistantRequest request, AssistantPreferences preferences)` — Opens the chat a catalog action asks for, on the person's gesture; refused where the service has no such road.
  - `void note(String event, Map<String, Object?> data)` — Writes one line of the assistant's log for a caller with no log of its own, the UI: the event and its data; inert unless the installed service writes it.
- **class `UnavailableAssistantService`** — The inert service used by tests and builds that have no accepted or experimental host adapter.
- **class `AssistantUnavailable`** — A safe refusal surfaced by the field dialog before any provider request.
  - `const AssistantUnavailable(this.code)` — Carries a localizable code only.
  - `final String code` — The refusal code.
- **enum `ConversationPhase`** — The typed phases of a text conversation.
  - values: `start`, `turn`, `finish`
- **class `ConversationTurn`** — An immutable text turn carrying the session's frozen target and context.
  - `ConversationTurn({ required this.sessionId, required this.phase, required this.target, required this.model, required this.viewer, required this.dra…` — Copies the context and history so a backend cannot mutate a later turn.
  - `final String sessionId` — The host-issued session identity.
  - `final ConversationPhase phase` — Start, user turn or local finish.
  - `final AssistantTarget? target` — The original semantic field and global identifier; null for a catalog action with no field.
  - `final AssistantModelSelection model` — The exact text model and provider chosen for this session.
  - `final String? viewer` — The viewer captured when the host bound the session; null where the action reads no project.
  - `final int? draftGeneration` — The original editable draft generation; null where the action reads no draft.
  - `Map<String, Object?> get context` — A private copy of the allowlisted initial context, never a live project read.
  - `final List<AssistantMessage> messages` — The preceding user and assistant messages in their original order.
  - `final String? input` — The current user message, present only for a user turn.
  - `final int turn` — The counted model turn, unchanged by Finish.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toJson()` — Serializes the existing plugin envelope without granting additional host authority.
- **class `AssistantSession`** — One memory-only conversation with a frozen model, and the field or request it opened for.
  - `AssistantSession({ required this.id, required this.target, required this.model, required this.backend, required Map<String, Object?> context, requi…` — Captures immutable JSON and watches only the supplied session's validity.
  - `final String id` — The host-issued opaque session identity.
  - `final AssistantTarget? target` — The validated original field; null for a catalog action with no field.
  - `final AssistantModelSelection model` — The frozen text route.
  - `final AssistantSessionBackend backend` — The host-owned execution binding.
  - `final String? viewer` — The original viewer handle, never a credential; null where the action reads no project.
  - `final int? draftGeneration` — The draft generation captured on opening; null where the action reads no draft.
  - `final AssistantApply? apply` — What *Apply* will do on the conversation's road, computed by the host on opening; null for a chat, which writes through the commands, and where nothing resolves.
  - `final AssistantRequest? request` — The catalog action this session opened for; null where none was given.
  - `final String? asks` — The question the dock asks before any model call, the action's `asks` where the project holds no summary (§6.11a); null where the session starts as it opens.
  - `bool get canApply` — Whether *Apply* may follow, on the conversation's road: the action has a finalize prompt, the field a string leaf, the host an apply; never for a chat (§6.11a).
  - `String? get proposalId` — The finalizer's proposal while it waits for the person (§6.11a).
  - `bool busy` — Whether one invocation is waiting or running.
  - `String? error` — The last localizable error; transcript and unsent input are kept after an error.
  - `String? get says` — The provider's own words for [error], while it is the error they came with (§6.11a); null otherwise.
  - `AssistantReply? result` — The last completed result, including its finalization marker.
  - `ChangeNotice? changeNotice` — The model's last refused change and whether it corrected it, for the person to see (§6.11a); null where none.
  - `List<AssistantMessage> get messages` — The transcript, immutable to callers and never persisted: [history] is what the chat's record keeps.
  - `List<Map<String, Object?>> get history` — The conversation as the chat's record keeps it (§7.4), a copy: the person's words and the assistant's final words with their `at`, and between them each turn's tool exchange in the host's wire shape; never a stopped t…
  - `ValueListenable<String> get partial` — The running turn's growing text, as the provider pushes it (§6.11a); empty while idle.
  - `ValueListenable<String> get note` — The running call's passing note (§6.11a): one at a time, replaced as it comes, empty when there is none and cleared when the call's words begin, the call ends or is stopped; never in [messages] nor told to the model.
  - `int get call` — The turn's model call under way, numbered from 1; 0 while idle.
  - `DateTime? get turnStartedAt` — When the running turn was sent, by [clock]; null while idle.
  - `static DateTime Function() clock` — The clock a turn's start and the dock's seconds read; a test sets its own.
  - `int get turns` — The number of potentially billed model turns, excluding explicit host refusals before admission.
  - `bool get stale` — Whether the binding was invalidated; a stale session cannot be retargeted.
  - `bool get completed` — Whether Finish has preserved the draft.
  - `Future<bool> settle(Future<void> deadline, {required Duration left})` — Lets the session's work end before its close is recorded (§7.4): the turn cancelled, then its own send and the host's tool call in flight awaited until [deadline] completes — which [left] it is from now; whether both…
  - `void hurry()` — Cancels a turn begun since the close began (§7.4): the film is being left or the app quits.
  - `void notice(String code)` — Shows [code] in the chat — a change the session could not record (§7.4) — until the next turn clears it.
  - `Future<void> start()` — Starts the greeting once, on the same user gesture that opened the dialog.
  - `void ask(String question)` — Shows [question] as the assistant's first words without a model call (§6.11a): the person's answer is the first turn, and the model reads the question before it.
  - `Future<void> send(String input)` — Sends nonblank user text once, retaining it in the transcript even on failure.
  - `Future<void> finish()` — Preserves the agreed text for later finalization without writing a project.
  - `void cancel()` — Stops only the current turn and keeps its potentially billed outcome uncertain.
  - `Future<bool> Function(String stage)? recorder` — Writes the chat's record for [stage] — `send`, `turn` — awaited at the turn's two edges (§7.4); whether it was written.
- **class `AssistantWhere`** — Where the person is, as the assistant reads it (§6.11a).
  - `const AssistantWhere({required this.rail, this.section, this.entity, this.pending, this.record, this.projectKey, this.tab, this.field})` — Names a place; nothing but the rail is known where no project is open.
  - `final String rail` — The rail's page by its name ([NavIndex.nameOf]).
  - `final String? section` — The page: null where no project is open, else an entity type's prefix, or `overview`, `script`, `other`, `batch`.
  - `final ExchangeId? entity` — The page's entity: the held field's, else the selected entity's, or the selected batch's; null on another page.
  - `final EntityType? pending` — The type of the pending set whose page this is (section `batch`, no entity: a set is no [ExchangeId]); null on another page.
  - `final EntityType? record` — The type of the set record whose page this is (section `batch`, a comp's or a chat's: a set is no [ExchangeId]); null on another page.
  - `final Object? projectKey` — Which project is open ([projectSourceKeyProvider]), null where none is; the dock's `session.stays` logs it.
  - `final String? tab` — The settled tab's name, served only while the rail is `project`.
  - `final AssistantFieldAt? field` — The field held, served only while the rail is `project` and the field is of the version the tabs show.
- **class `AssistantFieldAt`** — A field a form publishes as the one the person is at, with its owner's identity token (§6.11a).
  - `AssistantFieldAt({ required this.owner, required this.stem, required this.type, required this.section, this.sectionLabel, required this.pairId, req…` — Describes the field; [draft] is read only on the person's gesture, and [readPaths] is copied, never shared.
  - `final Object owner` — The publishing wrapper's identity: only it may take the field back.
  - `final String stem, type, section, pairId, label` — The version's full stem, its entity type's prefix, the form section's id, the field's pair id and its label.
  - `final String? sectionLabel` — The form section's title as the form shows it, which heads a form section's actions in the dock; null where the publisher has none.
  - `final List<String> readPaths` — The keys the form's field owns: one for a plain field, several for a composite such as media; never logged.
  - `final String? applyPath` — The one string leaf *Apply* may write; null where the field is for chat only.
  - `final AssistantDraft Function() draft` — Snapshots the form's draft.
- **variable** `final assistantWhereProvider` — Where the person is: derived from the rail, the selection and the project, published by the tabs and the field.
- **class `AssistantWhereController`** — Keeps [AssistantWhere]: the rail, page and entity derived, the tab and field published by their owners (§6.11a).
  - `String? get shownStem` — The full stem of the version the tabs show, the one [fieldGained] admits; null where no tabs report one.
  - `void fieldGained(AssistantFieldAt field)` — Holds [field], replacing any other, where it is of the version the tabs show on the project rail.
  - `void fieldLeft(Object owner)` — Clears the field only if [owner] holds it.
  - `void tabSettled(Object owner, String stem, String? tab)` — Takes the version the tabs show, by its full [stem], and their settled [tab].
- **class `AssistantShortcut`** — A press of an action's AI icon on a form, or of its chip in the dock, so that the two animate as one and the dock runs the action an icon asks for (§6.11a).
  - `const AssistantShortcut({required this.action, required this.from, required this.serial})` — The press of [action] [from] an icon or the chip, the [serial]th press of the session.
  - `final String action` — The action's id.
  - `final String from` — What was pressed: `field` or `section` for the icon on a field or on a section's title, `chip` for the dock's chip.
  - `final int serial` — Counts the presses, so that the same action pressed twice is two states.
- **variable** `final assistantShortcutProvider` — The last press of an action's icon or chip; null until one is pressed.
- **class `AssistantShortcutController`** — Carries each press (§6.11a): the icons and the dock listen; nothing is kept beyond the last press.
  - `void press(String action, {required String from})` — Says [action] was pressed [from] — `field`, `section` or `chip`; logged `assistant.shortcut`.
- **class `AssistantRequest`** — What an action opens: the assistant, the action and the place of the gesture (§6.11a).
  - `const AssistantRequest({required this.tag, required this.action, required this.where, this.target, this.draft})` — Binds [action] of [tag] to [where]; [target] and [draft] are a field action's.
  - `final String tag` — The assistant's package tag.
  - `final AssistantAction action` — The catalog's action.
  - `final AssistantWhere where` — Where the person was at the gesture; immutable, so it stays that place while the person moves on.
  - `final AssistantTarget? target` — The field a field action works on, else null.
  - `final AssistantDraft? draft` — The field's draft at the gesture, else null.
  - `bool stillOnPage(AssistantWhere now)` — Whether the person is still on the page this chat opened on, where its conversation is offered (§6.11a).
  - `bool stillAt(AssistantWhere now)` — Whether the person is still at the place this conversation opened: [stillOnPage], and for an action of level field, its field held, of the same stem and pair id.

### `lib/src/assistant_catalog.dart`

- **enum `AssistantLevel`** — Where an action is offered: on a held field, on every field of a form section, on a section, on a rail, or anywhere; in the order the dock lists them.
  - values: `field`, `formSection`, `section`, `rail`, `always`
- **class `AssistantExport`** — What an action hands the model of the open film: a scope name or a pattern.
  - `const AssistantExport()`
- **class `ScopeExport`** — An export by one of the exchange's registered scope names.
  - `const ScopeExport(this.name)`
  - `final String name` — The scope's name, validated against the exchange's registry.
- **class `PatternExport`** — An export by selector tokens, each with its projection.
  - `const PatternExport(this.lines)`
  - `final Map<String, ProjectionSpec> lines` — Each selector token → its projection, in file order.
- **class `ProjectionSpec`** — A pattern line's projection: a named projection or a list of field paths.
  - `const ProjectionSpec.named(String this.named)`
  - `const ProjectionSpec.paths(List<String> this.paths)`
  - `final String? named` — One of `everything`, `whole`, `summary`, `synopsis`, `frame`, `project_overview`.
  - `final List<String>? paths` — One or more field paths, with no upper bound.
- **class `AssistantAction`** — One action of the catalog: what the person can ask the assistant at a place.
  - `const AssistantAction({required this.id, required this.label, required this.prompt, this.finalize, this.models = const [], this.context = const [],…`
  - `final String id` — Unique in the file, `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,39}$`.
  - `final String label` — A key of the package's English strings.
  - `final String prompt` — The instruction sent to the model.
  - `final String? finalize` — The instruction that turns the answer into the field's value; only on a field's action.
  - `final List<String> models` — The action's catalogue model ids; empty: the catalog's defaults.
  - `final List<String> context` — What of the app's state the action reads: `activity`.
  - `final AssistantExport? export` — What of the open film the action hands the model, or none.
  - `final AssistantLevel level` — Where the action is offered.
  - `final String? rail` — The rail's validated name; null for an action offered anywhere.
  - `final String? section` — The section's validated name; null above a section.
  - `final String? effort` — The reasoning effort the action asks of the model, `low`, `medium` or `high`; null: the model's own default.
  - `final String? asks` — The question the dock asks itself, with no model call, where the project holds no summary (§6.11a); null: none.
  - `bool get needsProject` — Whether the action needs an open project: it exports something of it.
  - `Set<String> get needsEntityOf` — The type prefixes the page's entity must have for the export (the intersection over its entity tokens, or a tags scope's type); empty: no entity needed.
- **class `AssistantSection`** — A section of the project rail: its actions, its fields' actions and its form sections' actions.
  - `const AssistantSection({this.actions = const [], this.fields = const {}, this.formSections = const {}})`
  - `final List<AssistantAction> actions` — The section's actions.
  - `final Map<String, Map<String, List<AssistantAction>>> fields` — Form section id → field id → actions; both ids the author's text.
  - `final Map<String, List<AssistantAction>> formSections` — Form section id → actions, offered on every field of that form section; the id the author's text.
- **class `AssistantRail`** — A rail section of the app: its actions and, on the project rail only, its sections.
  - `const AssistantRail({this.actions = const [], this.sections = const {}})`
  - `final List<AssistantAction> actions` — The rail's actions.
  - `final Map<String, AssistantSection> sections` — Section name → section; project only.
- **class `AssistantCatalog`** — A catalog read whole: the assistant's defaults and its actions by place.
  - `const AssistantCatalog({this.format = 1, this.portrait, this.conversation = const [], this.models = const [], this.always = const [], this.rails =…`
  - `final int format` — The format's version: 1.
  - `final String? portrait` — The portrait's path in the package, or none.
  - `final List<String> conversation` — The voice conversation providers: `openai`, `grok`; empty: chat only.
  - `final List<String> models` — The assistant's default model ids.
  - `final List<AssistantAction> always` — The actions offered anywhere.
  - `final Map<String, AssistantRail> rails` — Rail name → rail.
  - `Iterable<AssistantAction> get actions` — Every action, for counts and the host's checks.
- **class `AssistantCatalogRefused`** — A catalog refused whole: a format code and the location of the first problem.
  - `const AssistantCatalogRefused(this.code, this.location, [this.value])`
  - `final String code, location` — What refused the file, and where.
  - `final Object? value` — The value found at [location], logged whole beside the code; not part of equality.
- **function** `AssistantCatalog readAssistantCatalog(String text, {required bool Function(String key) hasEnglishLabel})` — Reads [text], a catalog file, whole or not at all.
- **class `AssistantActionGroup`** — The actions of one level for a place.
  - `const AssistantActionGroup(this.level, this.actions)`
  - `final AssistantLevel level` — The level the actions are offered at.
  - `final List<AssistantAction> actions` — The level's actions, in file order.
- **function** `List<AssistantActionGroup> actionsFor(AssistantCatalog catalog, {required String rail, String? section, String? fieldSection, String? fieldKey})` — The actions for a place, in the owner's order: the held field's, its form section's (offered on every field of it), the section's, the rail section's, then those offered anywhere; an empty level is left out.

### `lib/src/assistant_session_ledger.dart`

- **class `Attribution`** — Which chat's command a write was made for (§7.4): read from the Zone at a write door, never an argument.
  - `const Attribution({ required this.command, required this.session, required this.assistantSession, this.operation, this.assistant, this.summary, })` — An attribution of a chat's command, the host's id and the command's trusted name required.
  - `final String command` — The trusted `source/name` of the command, from the registry.
  - `final String session` — The app run's command session (`CommandRegistry.session`).
  - `final String? operation` — The call's `operation`, the host's key per call.
  - `final String assistantSession` — The chat's own id, the host's `action-<µs>-<n>`.
  - `final String? assistant` — The selected assistant's id.
  - `final String? summary` — The command's `summary` argument, as handed.
  - `static Attribution? get current` — The attribution of the code running now, or null for a person's write.
  - `static T run<T>(Attribution attribution, T Function() body)` — Runs [body] attributed to [attribution].
  - `static T cleared<T>(T Function() body)` — Runs [body] with no attribution: a person's own write, inside a command's scope or not.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toLog()` — The attribution as a log line's data: every member as it is, the absent left out.
- **enum `WriteKind`** — How a write changed an entity (§7.4).
  - values: `fork`, `create`, `patch`, `epoch`, `pick`
- **class `EntityWritten`** — One write the controller made, published after it landed and never where nothing was written (§7.4).
  - `const EntityWritten({ required this.stem, required this.kind, required this.projectKey, required this.author, this.before, this.after, this.from, t…` — A receipt of one landed write.
  - `final String stem` — The version written, or for a pick the version picked (see the class).
  - `final WriteKind kind` — How the write changed the entity.
  - `final String projectKey` — The film the write was asked in, as `projectKeyOf` names it at the door's entry.
  - `final Author? author` — The viewer the write went out as; null where there was none, and the writer refused.
  - `final Map<String, dynamic>? before` — The whole version as it was before an in-place write ([WriteKind.patch]); null for the other kinds.
  - `final Map<String, dynamic>? after` — The document as written; null for a pick, and for a flag whose file could not be read back.
  - `final String? from` — A pick's version before: the viewer's own pick, null where they had none.
  - `final String? to` — A pick's version after: the version picked, official's on a return to official, null where nothing is.
  - `final Attribution? attribution` — The chat the write was made for; null for a person's write.
  - `final String? epoch` — An [WriteKind.epoch]'s token; [before] is then the entry it relabelled, null where it was appended, and [after] the entry as written.
- **class `WriteObserver`** — Hears every write the controller made, awaited by the write (§7.4): the default hears nothing.
  - `const WriteObserver()` — An observer that hears nothing.
  - `Future<void> written(EntityWritten event)` — Called once per write, after it landed; the write returns only when this has.
- **variable** `final assistantSessionsProvider` — The live chats and their ledgers (§7.4); the app's quit closes every one, an exit task while it lives.
- **variable** `final assistantLiveChatsProvider` — The ids of the chats open in this app (§7.4), as the ledgers publish them at each open and close: the tree's *Chats* says *archived* of a record whose `assistant_session` is not among them (§8.2).
- **class `AssistantLiveChats`** — Holds [assistantLiveChatsProvider]'s ids, set only by [AssistantSessionLedgers].
- **variable** `final writeObserverProvider` — The one [WriteObserver] the controller awaits: the Assistant Sessions' ledgers.
- **class `AssistantSessionLedgers`** — The ledger of each live Assistant Session, by the host's id: the controller's [WriteObserver] (§7.4), and the sessions' close.
  - `AssistantSessionLedgers(this._ref)` — The ledgers over [_ref], none until a chat writes.
  - `void Function(String id, String reason)? onCloseBegun` — Told each new close's session id and reason, once that close is kept in [_closes]: the dock ends a chat whose close it did not begin (§6.11a).
  - `void Function(String id, String stem)? onFirstItem` — Told once per session, the session id and its record's stem, when its first content item — not a pick — is recorded: the dock moves to the record's page from there (§6.11a).
  - `String? get leaving` — The reason of a [closeAll] under way — `film_changed` or `quit` —, else null: a chat opened meanwhile would outlive the film it was opened in, so the dock does not install one (§6.11a).
  - `AssistantSessionLedger? of(String id)` — The ledger of the session [id], once it wrote.
  - `bool isLive(String id)` — Whether the session [id] is live in this app: its ledger kept, so its record is still its own to write.
  - `bool closeBegun(String id)` — Whether the close of the session [id] has begun, whoever asked it; it stays true once that close has ended.
  - `Future<bool> opened(AssistantSession session)` — Takes [session] as open — a film left and the app's quit close it with the others — and writes its record at once (§7.4): `status: open`, no item, its history, in the film open now as its viewer, so that a chat is rec…
  - `Future<void> close(AssistantSession session, String reason, {Duration within = assistantCloseLimit})` — Closes [session] once, for [reason] — `closed`, `reviewed`, `assistant_changed`, `film_changed` or `quit` (§7.4): its turn cancelled and its work in flight let settle until the record's slice before its deadline, [wit…
  - `Future<void> closeSession(String id, String reason)` — Closes the open chat [id] for [reason] ([close]): a review press on its record's page (§7.4).
  - `Future<void> closeAll(String reason, {required Duration within})` — Closes every open chat for [reason] at once and returns once each ledger is let go, within [within], its record closed where its last write landed by then: a close already under way is held to that deadline where it i…
- **class `AssistantSessionLedger`** — One Assistant Session's writes, kept as its `as` record (Project Specification §12.7; §7.4).
  - `final Attribution attribution` — The opening's ids, or the first write's attribution: the session's run, id and assistant.
  - `final String started` — When the chat opened, or its first write was heard, RFC 3339: the record's `started`.
  - `final String? action, entity` — The record's `action` and `entity` (§12.7): the catalog action the chat opened with, and the entity a field's or form section's action opened at — from the chat's own request, never from its writes, whose first may be…
  - `List<Map<String, Object?>> get items` — The items as kept, in order.
  - `List<Map<String, Object?>> get picks` — The picks as kept, in order.
  - `SetRecord? get record` — The record as last written, or null before one landed.

### `lib/src/assistant_session_review.dart`

- **variable** `final sessionReviewProvider` — The one door of an Assistant Session's review (§7.4): [SessionReview] over the opened project's controller.
- **typedef** `typedef ReviewAnswer` — What the review did with one item: its `n`, `picked`, `discarded`, `refused` or `skipped`, and a code where there is one to say (§7.4).
- **class `SessionReview`** — Picks and discards the items of the viewer's own `as` record, as the person and never inside a chat (§7.4).
  - `SessionReview(this._ref)` — The review over [_ref]'s opened project.
  - `Future<ReviewAnswer> pick(BatchStem record, int n, String side)` — Picks one side of item [n] of [record]: `left` the version the session wrote, `right` a fork's recorded `base`.
  - `Future<List<ReviewAnswer>> pickAll(BatchStem record)` — Picks the left side of every item of [record] in order of `n`, skipping one gone, discarded or decided.
  - `Future<ReviewAnswer> discard(BatchStem record, int n)` — Discards item [n] of [record] through the one door, `setDiscarded`: set aside, never deleted (§3.6).

### `lib/src/assistant_voice.dart`

- **enum `AssistantVoiceProvider`** — An explicit experimental voice route, independent of text and dictation preferences.
  - values: `grok`, `openai`
  - `String get model` — The actual provider model requested on the wire, never a text-model mapping.
  - `String get platform` — The existing provider credential identity.
- **enum `AssistantVoicePhase`** — The visible state of an owner-started spoken conversation.
  - values: `ready`, `connecting`, `listening`, `thinking`, `speaking`, `finishing`, `ended`, `error`
- **enum `AssistantTranscriptState`** — Whether an input transcript is arriving, awaiting completion, final or incomplete.
  - values: `receiving`, `pending`, `complete`, `incomplete`
- **class `AssistantVoiceMessage`** — A memory-only transcript entry, including whether generated speech was interrupted.
  - `const AssistantVoiceMessage(this.id, this.role, this.text, { this.interrupted = false, this.transcription = AssistantTranscriptState.complete, })` — Keeps the provider item identity so partial transcripts update their own turn.
  - `final String id` — The provider item identifier, used only within this session.
  - `final String role` — Either user or assistant.
  - `final String text` — The generated or recognized text, never diagnostic data.
  - `final bool interrupted` — Whether some generated speech may not have been heard.
  - `final AssistantTranscriptState transcription` — The input transcript's finality, independent of assistant response timing.
- **class `AssistantVoiceSession`** — An inertly opened conversation whose microphone and provider start only on Start voice.
  - `AssistantVoiceProvider get provider` — The frozen voice provider selected before Start.
  - `AssistantVoicePhase get phase` — The current listening, processing, playback or terminal state.
  - `String? get error` — A closed local error code, never provider text or a credential.
  - `bool get muted` — Whether microphone capture is released until the owner unmutes.
  - `Duration get elapsed` — The elapsed session time, running on through Finish's drain; the clock a cap given to the session reads.
  - `List<AssistantVoiceMessage> get messages` — The transcript retained through End conversation and Finish until Close.
  - `Map<String, int> get reportedUsage` — Provider-reported token counts available so far, separate from a charge.
  - `bool get started` — Whether Start has already been used; no automatic retry or restart occurs.
  - `bool get capReached` — Whether the cap itself finished this session (§6.11), so that the dialog says so; a person's Finish or End never sets it, and a new conversation is a new Start.
  - `String? get microphoneBusyOwner` — The owner that held the microphone when Start was refused with `mic_busy`, by its nonsecret name (§9.6).
  - `AssistantApply? get apply` — What *Apply* will do, set by the host on opening; null where nothing resolves (§6.11a).
  - `set apply(AssistantApply? value)`
  - `AssistantReply? get finalized` — How a revision-6 finalizer ended — completed with the proposal's id or `nothing`, or an error's code — and null before it ends; the host clears the id once the proposal is applied or discarded (§6.11a).
  - `set finalized(AssistantReply? value)`
  - `void Function()? onDisposed` — Told once when the session is disposed — its dialog closed — so the host ends what it holds for it (§6.11a).
  - `Future<void> start()` — Starts the one session only after the owner's explicit gesture.
  - `Future<void> setMuted(bool value)` — Releases or reacquires the microphone while preserving this provider session.
  - `Future<void> end()` — Releases all live resources while retaining a readable transcript and draft.
  - `Future<ConversationFinishReason> finish()` — Stops input, commits what was said, drains the admitted captions for at most five seconds, then ends with the transcript frozen (§6.11); a session without a drain of its own ends at once.
- **class `AssistantVoiceService`** — The private voice service installed only in the dedicated native voice build.
  - `static AssistantVoiceService? get current` — The app's optional native service; null preserves the existing text flow.
  - `static void install(AssistantVoiceService? service)` — Installs the native service, or null to retire it, without opening a session.
  - `static Stream<void> get installations` — Signals replacement to consumers that already read the service.
  - `List<AssistantVoiceProvider> get providers` — The routes supported on this device, in default-selection order, without checking keys.
  - `void note(String event, Map<String, Object?> data)` — Writes one line of the voice road's log for a caller with no log of its own, the dialog (§6.11a).
  - `AssistantApply? admissionOf(AssistantRequest request)` — What *Apply* would do for a catalog action's [request], said before Start: an inert read, null where nothing resolves or the service has no catalog road.
  - `Future<AssistantVoiceSession> openAction(AssistantVoiceRequest request, AssistantPreferences preferences, AssistantVoiceProvider provider,)` — Opens a catalog action's conversation from the Start gesture; refused where the service has no such road.
- **class `AssistantVoiceRequest`** — A catalog action's voice request: the action's request and the providers it may speak through (§6.11a).
  - `const AssistantVoiceRequest({required this.request, required this.providers})` — Pairs [request] with [providers].
  - `final AssistantRequest request` — The action's request, with the place of the gesture.
  - `final List<AssistantVoiceProvider> providers` — The catalog's voice providers that this device supports, in its order.

### `lib/src/automation_host.dart`

- **class `AutomationHost`** — The seam the agent layer attaches to: what an agent may ask the running application, as an interface with a no-op default.
  - `const AutomationHost()`

  - `static final GlobalKey windowKey` — The `RepaintBoundary` above the navigator (`lib/app.dart`'s `MaterialApp.builder`): the whole view as Flutter draws it.
  - `bool get isAvailable` — Whether this host can act at all; the no-op host cannot.
  - `bool get withholdsAccount` — Whether the app leaves the sign-in hint alone, restoring no session of the person's, while an agent build's account mode restores the test account's itself (§6.6).
  - `void attach(ProviderContainer container)` — Called once by `main` with the container every provider lives in.
  - `Future<Map<String, Object?>> state()` — What is on screen: the open project, the selection, the tab, the viewer — as data an agent can read.
  - `Future<void> navigate(Selection selection)` — Shows [selection], as a tree click would.
  - `Future<void> setTab(String tab)` — Opens the tab named [tab] on the current page.
  - `Future<bool> tap(String identifier)` — Taps the element carrying the semantics [identifier]; false when no such element is on screen.
  - `Future<bool> setField(String stem, String key, String text)` — Types [text] into the field [key] of the form editing [stem], through the form's own setter (`FieldRegistry`), so the autosave, the identity lock and the stale refusal hold as for a person.
  - `Future<Uint8List?> screenshot()` — A PNG of the whole view ([windowKey], dialogs included), or null when the host cannot paint one.
  - `Future<Object?> semantics()` — The semantics tree as data: labels, identifiers, actions.
  - `Future<List<String>> logTail({int lines = 50})` — The last [lines] of the application's log.
  - `Future<void> openProject(String? path)` — Opens the project folder at [path], or the bundled sample when [path] is null — the project menu's two doors.
  - `Future<void> setViewer(String handle)` — Sets the username through Settings' own transition (§9.4): an empty handle is `default`, and one that is not a handle, or a change an open draft could not be written before, is refused and changes nothing.
  - `Future<void> setLocale(String? code)` — Chooses the language by its code (`en`, `es`) as Settings does, or the platform's language when [code] is null.
  - `Future<void> setTheme(String mode)` — Chooses the theme as Settings does: `system`, `light` or `dark`.
  - `List<String>? takePickedFiles()` — The files an agent chose for the next file dialog, given once: null where none waits, so the dialog opens; empty where the agent cancels it.
- **class `NoOpAutomationHost`** — The host of every product build: answers "not available" to everything and does nothing.
  - `const NoOpAutomationHost()`

### `lib/src/command_registry.dart`

- **enum `CommandCaller`** — Who called a command: the in-app voice conversation, the relay behind *Remote control*, or the text assistant.
  - values: `voice`, `relay`, `text`
- **typedef** `typedef CommandHandler` — What a command runs on a call.
- **class `Command`** — One thing the app offers a model: an MCP tool with its own handler (§7.3).
  - `const Command({ required this.source, required this.name, required this.title, required this.description, required this.inputSchema, required this.…`
  - `final String source` — `builtin`, or a plug-in's tag.
  - `final String name` — The public kebab name inside [source].
  - `final String title` — The tool's title, shown to a model's person.
  - `final String description` — What the tool does, for a model choosing it.
  - `final Map<String, Object?> inputSchema` — A raw JSON Schema whose `type` is `object`, announced as it is.
  - `final Map<String, Object?>? outputSchema` — The schema of `structured` in a success, where the command gives one.
  - `final Map<String, Object?>? meta` — The MCP tool's `_meta`, opaque, at most 8 KiB serialized.
  - `final bool exposed` — Whether the relay may call it; voice and text may call any command.
  - `final bool effectful` — Whether it takes `session` and `operation` and runs under the operation ledger.
  - `final bool readOnly` — Announced as `readOnlyHint`: the command changes nothing.
  - `final bool destructive` — Announced as `destructiveHint`: the command may remove something.
  - `final CommandHandler handler` — What a call runs once dispatch has admitted it.
  - `final Set<String> codes` — The fixed refusal codes its handler may answer, beside the registry's own.
  - `final Set<String> checkedByHandler` — The arguments whose schema is announced and read at registration whole, but whose value the handler checks itself, against what it alone knows (an entity's own type), with the detailed answer: the call's schema check…
- **class `CommandResult`** — A command's answer, in the shape of an MCP `CallToolResult`.
  - `const CommandResult({this.content = const [], this.structured, this.meta, this.isError = false})`
  - `factory CommandResult.ok({Map<String, Object?>? structured, String? text, Map<String, Object?>? meta})` — A success with [structured] and, when given, [text] as its one text item.
  - `factory CommandResult.refusal(String code, {Map<String, Object?> extra = const {}})` — A refusal: `isError`, the fixed [code] as `structured.error` and as the text.
  - `final List<Map<String, Object?>> content` — The MCP content items: text, an image, a link.
  - `final Map<String, Object?>? structured` — The machine-readable answer, `structuredContent` on the wire.
  - `final Map<String, Object?>? meta` — The result's MCP `_meta`, opaque.
  - `final bool isError` — Whether this answers a refusal or a failure.
  - `Map<String, Object?> toJson()` — The MCP `CallToolResult` JSON.
- **class `CommandContext`** — What a handler is given for one call.
  - `final String ref` — The local call reference, `c-<counter>`: the only id the log carries.
  - `final CommandCaller caller` — Who called.
  - `final Command command` — The command being run.
  - `final Map<String, Object?> args` — The validated arguments, control fields included.
  - `final DateTime? deadline` — When the caller stops waiting, if it does.
  - `final String authority` — [CommandRegistry.authority] as it was at the call: the film the handler acts on.
  - `final String? assistantSession` — The chat that made the call, the host's `action-<µs>-<n>`: set by the host, never a model's argument; null for a caller that is no chat (the relay, the agent layer).
  - `final String? assistant` — The selected assistant's id, beside [assistantSession].
  - `Future<CommandRefusal?> admit()` — The effect gate, called immediately before an effect: null when it may start, else the refusal to return.
  - `CommandRefusal? check()` — The refusal [admit] would answer now, or null, admitting nothing: for a read-only handler before outward work.
  - `void observe(String outcome, {String? label})` — Raises the observation the root turns into a message, [label] the name it shows.
- **class `CommandRefusal`** — A refusal [CommandContext.admit] answers; the handler returns [result] unrun.
  - `const CommandRefusal(this.code)`
  - `final String code` — The fixed refusal code.
  - `CommandResult get result` — The refusal as the handler returns it.
- **class `CommandObservation`** — A command's visible outcome, for the root's message.
  - `const CommandObservation({ required this.ref, required this.caller, required this.source, required this.name, required this.outcome, this.label, })`
  - `final String ref` — The call's local reference.

  - `final String source` — The command's source.
  - `final String name` — The command's name.
  - `final String outcome` — `ok`, or the refusal's code.

  - `Map<String, List<String>> allowed(Map<String, Object?> schema, Object? value)` — For each `notAllowed` path of [value] under [schema], the keys the object there takes.

  - `const NoCommandValidator()`

  - `final String code` — The fixed refusal code.

  - `static Stream<CommandObservation> get observations` — Each command's visible outcome as it raises it.

  - `static String session` — This app run's session, a UUID the root makes at start; empty refuses every effectful call.

  - `static DateTime Function() clock` — The clock deadlines and the ledger read.
  - `static String instructions({String separator = '.'})` — The text the catalogue carries for a model: one English paragraph, not localised.
  - `static List<Command> get all` — Every command, in registration order.
  - `static Command? find(String source, String name)` — The command [source]/[name], or null.
  - `static void register(Command command)` — Adds [command], or throws [CommandRegistrationException] with `name`, `duplicate`, `not-object`, `schema-unsupported` or `meta-too-large`.
  - `static void unregister(String source, [String? name])` — Removes every command of [source], or only [name] when given.
  - `static Map<String, Object?> toolOf(Command command, {String separator = '.'})` — The MCP `Tool` announcing [command], named `<source><separator><name>`.
  - `static Future<CommandResult> call(String source, String name, CommandCaller caller, Map<String, Object?> args, { DateTime? deadline, bool Function(…` — Runs the command [source]/[name] for [caller]; every refusal is a [CommandResult], never a throw.
  - `static void resetForTest()` — Back to the inert defaults: no commands, no session, the default clock, validator and authority.

- **class `GroupInvitation`** — One invitation: to [group] where it is the target's, of [target] as [role], how it stands, until [expiresAt].
  - `const GroupInvitation({required this.id, this.group, required this.target, required this.role, required this.expiresAt, required this.state})` — An invitation of [target] to [group] as [role].
  - `final String id` — The invitation's id.
  - `final GroupName? group` — The group, where the target reads it; null on a group's own list.
  - `final GroupName target` — The invited person.
  - `final String role` — The role it offers.
  - `final int expiresAt` — When it lapses, in seconds since the epoch.
  - `final String state` — `pending`, `accepted`, `revoked`, `expired` or `unavailable`.
- **typedef** `typedef GroupPage<T>` — One page of a list and whether another follows at the next offset.
- **typedef** `typedef GroupDetail` — One group as a membership reads it: the members where [GroupMembership.manages], else none.
- **class `CommunityGroupsRefused`** — A refusal of a community call, by its code alone, with the website's status where one answered.
  - `const CommunityGroupsRefused(this.code, {this.status})` — A refusal under [code].
  - `final String code` — The refusal's code, for the consumer to word.
  - `final int? status` — The HTTP status that carried it; null where nothing was sent or nothing answered.
- **class `CommunityGroups`** — The account's groups and invitations (§6.6): each call answers its value or throws [CommunityGroupsRefused].
  - `const CommunityGroups()` — Creates a client without account or transport work.
  - `static CommunityGroups get current` — The installed client; [NoCommunityGroups] by default.
  - `static void install(CommunityGroups client)` — Installs [client] without calling it.
  - `Future<GroupPage<GroupMembership>> groups({int offset = 0})` — The memberships of every identity of the account (`GET /v1/community/self/groups`).
  - `Future<GroupMembership> create(String username)` — Makes the group [username], owned by the account's primary identity (`POST /v1/community/groups`).
  - `Future<GroupDetail> group(GroupMembership membership, {int offset = 0})` — [membership]'s group's roster, read as its identity (`GET /v1/community/groups/{g}`); empty for a member.
  - `Future<GroupInvitation> invite(GroupMembership membership, String username)` — Invites the person [username] as a member, as [membership]'s identity (`POST /v1/community/groups/{g}/invitations`).
  - `Future<GroupPage<GroupInvitation>> invitations(GroupMembership membership, {int offset = 0})` — The group's invitations, as [membership]'s identity, an owner's or an admin's (`GET …/groups/{g}/invitations`).
  - `Future<GroupPage<GroupInvitation>> received({int offset = 0})` — The pending invitations to the account's identities (`GET /v1/community/self/invitations`).
  - `Future<GroupMembership> accept(String id)` — Accepts the invitation [id], made to one of the account's identities (`POST …/self/invitations/{i}/accept`).
  - `Future<void> decline(String id)` — Declines the invitation [id] (`POST …/self/invitations/{i}/decline`).
  - `Future<void> leave(GroupMembership membership)` — [membership]'s identity leaves its group (`DELETE /v1/community/groups/{g}/members/{identity}`).
- **class `NoCommunityGroups`** — The client of a build that installed none: every call is refused `not-signed-in`; nothing is sent.
  - `const NoCommunityGroups()` — The inert client.

### `lib/src/comp_poster.dart`

- **variable** `final compPosterProvider` — Posts comps; the default answers *not available*, the app's composition posts to the comps service.
- **class `CompPoster`** — Posts a comp in two calls, so the posting is written before any request (§6.17).
  - `Future<CompPosting> prepare(SetRecord comp)` — Composes [comp]'s draft and prepares its bundle, with no request; throws a [CompPostException] on a refusal.
  - `Future<CompPostOutcome> publish(CompPosting posting)` — Sends [posting]'s bundle — the one prepared, else prepared again from the frozen posting — and answers its outcome.
  - `Future<CompPostOutcome> check(String revision)` — Reads the state of [revision] under the signed-in account.
  - `Future<CompPostOutcome> abandon(String revision)` — Deletes [revision]'s staging; a revision published first answers its published receipt.
  - `Stream<double> get progress` — The running publish's progress, 0 to 1: a broadcast stream, listened to by as many as like.
  - `void cancel()` — Cancels the running publish.
- **class `CompPosting`** — What a post is of, frozen before any request: the record's `posting` (§6.17).
  - `const CompPosting({ required this.stem, required this.revision, required this.slug, required this.project, required this.account, required this.dra…` — A posting of its parts.
  - `final String stem` — The comp record's stem.
  - `final String revision` — The revision the service knows the post by.
  - `final String slug` — The comp's address segment.
  - `final String project` — The project's tag the comp is filed under.
  - `final String account` — The account signed in when the post was prepared, the one every later call runs as.
  - `final Map<String, Object?> draft` — The comp's JSON as handed to the assembler.
  - `final Map<String, String> sources` — Each media's `source` id to the local file it was prepared from, so the same revision can be prepared again.
- **enum `CompPostState`** — A revision's state as the service answers it.
  - values: `receiving`, `published`, `cancelled`
- **class `CompPostOutcome`** — The outcome of a publish, a check or an abandon: the receipt's state, or a refusal's code and detail.
  - `const CompPostOutcome({required this.revision, this.state, this.url, this.code, this.detail, this.definite = false})` — An outcome of its parts.
  - `final String revision` — The revision answered for.
  - `final CompPostState? state` — The receipt's state; null on a refusal.
  - `final String? url` — The comp's public address, once published.
  - `final String? code` — The refusal's code; null where a receipt answered.
  - `final String? detail` — What the service said beside the code, for the log and the person's detail.
  - `final bool definite` — Whether the revision's fate is known: published, cancelled, or refused for good; else the post stays unsettled.
  - `bool get published` — Whether the revision is published at [url].
- **class `CompPostException`** — A refusal before any request: the comp could not be prepared.
  - `const CompPostException(this.code, {this.detail})` — A refusal with its [code] and [detail].
  - `final String code` — The stable code the page says in its own words.
  - `final String? detail` — What was refused and why, for the log.
- **class `UnavailableCompPoster`** — The poster where none is installed: every call answers *not available*.
  - `const UnavailableCompPoster()` — The poster of a build without the comps service.

### `lib/src/deadline.dart`

- **variable** `const Duration serverDiscoveryBudget` — The admission-inclusive whole-operation budget for server discovery.
- **class `Deadline`** — A pure operation deadline whose child limits consume the parent's remaining time.
  - `Deadline({required DateTime startedAt, required Duration budget, DateTime Function()? clock})` — Starts before admission, using an injectable clock without a timer or platform listener.
  - `final DateTime startedAt` — The start of the admitted operation, in UTC.
  - `final Duration budget` — The whole operation's budget, rather than a fresh per-request timeout.
  - `DateTime get deadline` — The absolute instant a host threads into its existing call-frame deadline.
  - `Duration get remaining` — The nonnegative remaining budget, bounded by the parent's and zero after cancellation.
  - `bool get isCancelled` — Whether this operation or any ancestor was explicitly cancelled.
  - `Future<void> get whenCancelled` — Completes on this operation's or an ancestor's cancellation, without starting a timer.
  - `void cancel()` — Cancels this operation and descendants once, without cancelling ancestors or siblings.
  - `Deadline child(Duration limit)` — Starts a child now with at most the requested limit and the parent's remaining budget.
